description: Agent-system production readiness registry. Manifest is the single source of truth. Routes/skills not listed here are treated as unknown (blocked at production entrypoints).

readiness_state_legend.non_ready: Known dependency missing (e.g. CLI not installed)
readiness_state_legend.contract_tested: Contract tests pass; not yet wired to runtime
readiness_state_legend.wired: Wired to runtime path; not yet smoke-verified

rules: Routes/skills absent from manifest => unknown => blocked at production entrypoints

executable defaults to false (never inferred from pipeline.steps or skill.json existence)
executor_type=system must be explicitly declared in manifest
unknown routes do not enter Opus planning candidates
unknown routes are not triggered by feishu/gateway implicit messages
contract_tested != production_ready; requires runtime evidence before promotion
